description: This file implements the StreamFactory class in the Slim Framework, responsible for creating StreamInterface instances from various sources such as strings, files, and resources.

classes.name: StreamFactory
classes.description: A factory class implementing StreamFactoryInterface to create StreamInterface objects from strings, files, or resources.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a stream from a string content, defaulting to an empty string.

methods.name: createStreamFromFile
methods.description: Creates a stream from a specified file, with error handling for fopen failures.

methods.name: createStreamFromResource
methods.description: Creates a stream from a given resource, throwing an exception if the parameter is not a resource.
